evidence.field: file description, original-file link, source provenance and license
evidence.text: The Commons page identifies 巴-oracle.svg as a modern Inkscape vector depiction of 巴 in a Shang oracle-script style and links its source to image J30397 on Hanziyuan. It labels the period as needing specification. The page states the vector representation is public domain. This is a redraw candidate, not a photograph of an ancient artifact, and the script identification and source attribution are Commons’ claims.

evidence.text: The inspected 巴-oracle.svg Commons page exposes the original SVG link at https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/bd/%E5%B7%B4-oracle.svg. Following it through the web tool failed because the tool rejected the SVG content type; this is a tool access failure, not evidence that the URL is invalid.

evidence.text: The Commons page identifies 父-oracle.svg as a modern Inkscape vector depiction of 父 in Shang oracle-script style and ties the represented form to Academia Sinica image 41.EEDF. It states CC0 1.0/public-domain reuse. This redraw illustrates only the component 父, not an early occurrence of the complete graph 爸.

evidence.text: The inspected 父-oracle.svg page exposes https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/9/95/%E7%88%B6-oracle.svg as the original SVG. Following the link failed with a cache miss in the web tool. The inspected description page still establishes the file identity, source attribution, and license.

evidence.text: The Commons page identifies 父-seal.svg as a modern vector depiction of 父 in Shuowen seal-script style, linked to Hanziyuan image s02164. search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 巴-oracle.svg 父-oracle.svg 父-seal.svg; Wikimedia Commons File 巴-oracle.svg
search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced Commons descriptions for the 巴 and 父 oracle-script SVG candidates. Their pages were opened and inspected.

search_audit.query: Open Commons 巴-oracle.svg, 父-oracle.svg, 父-seal.svg; follow actual Original file links
search_audit.outcome: Commons pages exposed real original-file links for 巴-oracle and 父-oracle. The web tool could not fetch the 巴 SVG due to unsupported content type and returned a cache miss for 父 SVG. The 父-seal Original file click redirected to a category page, so its direct image URL could not be recovered and was excluded.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File 爸.svg character 爸 ancient Chinese
search_audit.outcome: Search did not locate a candidate for a historical 爸 graph. Returned results included unrelated glyphs and the already identified 父 component image.

gaps: No usable historical image candidate for the complete graph 爸 was located in these searches. Candidate images below depict component graphs only and must not imply that 爸 existed in the Shang or seal-script periods.
The web tool could not return the 巴 and 父 oracle SVG pixels, and the 父-seal original link redirected incorrectly. No visual inspection is claimed.
The 巴 Commons page itself marks its period as needing specification; the Shang-style attribution is a source description, not a securely dated artifact identification.

items.period: Purported Shang oracle-script style; Commons file page flags the period as needing specification.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw based on Hanziyuan image J30397, according to Commons.
items.caption: Modern redraw of a 巴 form catalogued in an oracle-script style; its period is not specified on the file page.
items.alt: Vector drawing of a historical-script form identified as 巴.
items.selection_reason: Shows the proposed sound component’s candidate early form. It illustrates 巴 alone, not the full character 爸, and its original referent is disputed.
items.rights: Public domain dedication stated on Commons for the SVG representation.

items.period: Shang oracle-script style, as described by Commons; candidate graphic period, not an attestation date for 爸.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style; modern vector redraw linked by Commons to Academia Sinica record 41.EEDF.
items.caption: Modern redraw of a 父 form in an oracle-script style; this component image does not attest the complete graph 爸.
items.alt: Vector drawing of a historical-script form identified as 父.
items.selection_reason: Provides a component comparison for 父, which is analyzed as the semantic element of 爸. It must not be presented as a glyph of 爸.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain dedication stated on Commons for the image.

limitations.text: These are source-described modern SVG redrawings, not photographs of excavated inscriptions. Although their original image URLs were recovered from the Commons pages, the web tool could not render or fetch the SVG pixels; review the downloaded files before publication.

The 父-seal candidate was excluded because its Commons Original file link redirected to a category and no direct image URL was established. The search did not establish an image candidate for the complete graph 爸.
